summary: PHASE 8C Accounting Dashboard frontend validation PASSED 100%. Accounting user (accounting@safarcrm.com) lands on /dashboard and sees data-testid=accounting-dashboard with title 'Accounting Dashboard' + period 2026-08. All 30 required data-testids present with real numbers (ki-revenue Rp 293.4jt, ki-payment Rp 293.4jt, ki-invoice Rp 293.4jt, tx-dpp Rp 300.5jt, tx-ppn Rp 0.9jt, tx-payable Rp 0.9jt, ao-commission=1, ao-tax Rp 0.9jt). All 6 recharts containers rendered (Cash Flow, Cash In Trend, Receivable Aging, Payment Status, Revenue by Package, Expense Breakdown). All 6 Accounting Outstanding tiles are clickable and navigate correctly: ao-unpaid/ao-overdue/ao-receivable -> /accounting, ao-refund -> /approvals, ao-commission -> /commission, ao-tax -> /tax. Regression: Sales user does NOT see accounting-dashboard and correctly sees sales-dashboard; Super Admin does NOT see accounting-dashboard and correctly sees the original dashboard-page.

issues: 6th slot is a literal em dash (—) placeholder with empty value (cosmetic, same pattern as Sales dashboard Booking group flagged in iteration_19)

action_items: Optional cosmetic: replace the empty '—' placeholder in the Money Out group of AccountingDashboard.jsx with a real KPI or remove the placeholder tile
critical_code_review_comments: AccountingDashboard.jsx uses hard-coded route strings (/accounting, /approvals, /commission, /tax) — all verified to match registered routes. Recommend centralising to route constants (config/nav.js) to avoid Phase 8B-style drift.
No null-guards on nested response fields (d.trends.cash_in, d.receivable.*, d.tax.*). If the API ever returns partial data, the map/spread will crash. Consider optional chaining + defaults.
Recharts responsive containers hard-code height 240 — chart aspect ratio may look cramped on mobile.
No loading skeleton per section — a single spinner blocks the entire page; consider partial skeletons like Dashboard.jsx.
Error path returns bare text 'Gagal memuat dashboard.' with no retry button.
